card.name: First digit of a dose amount
card.fires_on: The first digit of a dose number in dosing text, such as the 2 in 1,250 mg or the 3 in 300 mg. It also fires on a space just before a duration number.

modes.label: Digit starting a dose
modes.description: A leading digit of a milligram dose, often after a comma in 1,250 or after a drug name like nilotinib.
